lore.bio:
Born in the unforgiving Frontier, Dr. Ashleigh Reid - still very much a human - learned early that the only person who was going to look out for her was herself. A humble lab assistant by day, she spent her nights in underground fighting rings, drug dens, and in the company of mercenaries. Over time, she learned the joys of psychological warfare: if she could break an opponent mentally, the battle was won before she even lifted a finger.
One day, she was hired by a mercenary group for a delicate job: steal an experimental fuel source being researched in the Outlands city of Olympus. It was the perfect job for Reid, who infiltrated and psychologically manipulated the researchers for years. She almost got what she wanted, but at the last moment, the researchers sacrificed themselves to destroy the lab. When it collapsed, Reid died with it... and didn't.
Her brain was put in a simulacrum shell, but in the process, she lost years of memories, and the trauma of her "death" caused her personality to fracture. Ash is the embodiment of the cold, perfectionistic, power-hungry side of Dr. Reid. After an encounter with Horizon overrides Ash's simulacrum programming, the framework that kept the vulnerable - yet intelligent - Leigh personality dormant has begun to crack. Ash joins the Games to prove she has transcended all humanity. Leigh's determined to prove her wrong.

For more information on Ash's story, see Ash (character).

passive.name: Predator's Pursuit
passive.description: Added an omnidirectional short-range dash with increased velocity.

tactical.name: Arc Snare
tactical.description: Throw a spinning snare that damages and tethers the first enemy that gets too close.

ultimate.name: Phase Breach
ultimate.description: Tear open a one-way portal to a targeted location. Nearby enemies will be highlighted for players traveling through the Void.

tactics.playstyle: Ash is a surgical flanker. Use her tactical to lock down fleeing targets and her ultimate for instant vertical or horizontal repositioning. She favors versatile weapons and quick finishes.

right.name: Ghost in the Machine
right.description: Tactical duration in world is tripled and can catch multiple enemies.

details: [Passive] Nerf -> Predator's Pursuit: dash cooldown increased to 12s.
[Tactical] Adjust -> Arc Snare: breaks more easily, base duration now 6s.
[Passive] Buff -> Passive: decreased dash cooldown to 8s (was 10s)
[Perks] Adjust -> Upgrades: Level 2 - Dual Breach: moved to Level 2
[Perks] Adjust -> Predator’s Pursuit: removed Death Box minimap locations/pings
[Passive] Buff -> Predator's Pursuit: added omnidirectional short-range dash.
[Tactical] Buff -> Arc Snare: tether plants at location of projectile on impact, slightly harder to break and no longer gets instantly broken by some abilities.

[Tactical] Buff -> Phase Breach: range increased to 100m, travel time reduced, improved reliability of placement, removed one frame delay on placement preview, now has VFX to show max range when in placement mode.
[Perks] Adjust -> Upgrades: Level 2 - Greedy Snare moved to Level 2, Dual Breach adds additional ult charge.
[Perks] Adjust -> Upgrades: Level 3 - Ghost in the Machine adds additional Dash charge.
[Ultimate] Buff -> Phase Breach: inspired by some Alter tech, nearby enemies will be highlighted for players traveling through the Void
